rng = np.random.default_rng(13)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 5, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (5, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
